author: ABMN Staff
title: Analysts’ Price Target Changes for January, 30th (AAPL, AGN, AMZN, CIT, CVLT, EA, EYEN, GXI, HCA, IPHI)
text:
Posted by ABMN Staff on Jan 30th, 2019 // No Comments
Analysts’ price target changes for Wednesday, January 30th:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was given a $140.00 target price by analysts at Goldman Sachs Group Inc. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock. Get Apple Inc alerts:
Allergan (NYSE:AGN) had its target price trimmed by Mizuho to $200.00. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Amazon.com (NASDAQ:AMZN) had its price target increased by BMO Capital Markets from $2,250.00 to $2,300.00. They currently have an outperform rating on the stock.
CIT Group (NYSE:CIT) had its target price boosted by Oppenheimer Holdings Inc. from $49.00 to $61.00. Oppenheimer Holdings Inc. currently has an outperform rating on the stock.
CommVault Systems (NASDAQ:CVLT) had its price target increased by Lake Street Capital to $69.00. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Electronic Arts (NASDAQ:EA) had its target price reduced by MKM Partners to $112.00. They currently have a buy rating on the stock.
Eyenovia (NASDAQ:EYEN) had its target price raised by HC Wainwright from $12.00 to $14.00. HC Wainwright currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Gerresheimer (ETR:GXI) was given a €49.50 ($57.56) price target by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co.. The firm currently has a sell rating on the stock.
HCA Healthcare (NYSE:HCA) had its price target increased by Oppenheimer Holdings Inc. from $142.00 to $150.00. The firm currently has an outperform rating on the stock.
Inphi (NYSE:IPHI) had its price target boosted by Craig Hallum from $40.00 to $48.00. They currently have a buy rating on the stock.
Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT) was given a $123.00 price target by analysts at Goldman Sachs Group Inc. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Sarepta Therapeutics (NASDAQ:SRPT) had its price target increased by Piper Jaffray Companies from $168.00 to $200.00. They currently have an overweight rating on the stock.
Suedzucker (ETR:SZU) was given a €12.00 ($13.95) target price by analysts at Goldman Sachs Group Inc. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Volkswagen (ETR:VOW3) was given a €203.00 ($236.05) target price by analysts at Credit Suisse Group AG. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
